name: aitp-research-protocol
description: Kimi Code plugin for the local AITP 1.0 v5 physics research graph kernel.
author: bhjia-phys

interface.shortDescription: Use the local AITP research graph memory from Kimi Code.
interface.longDescription: Connects Kimi Code to the repository-backed AITP 1.0 v5 MCP server and installs skills for typed physics research memory workflows. Includes a first-run setup mode and session-start research routing.
